Company Background: CGRL (Colored Gemstone Research Laboratory) is a comprehensive technical laboratory equipped with advanced analytical instruments and staffed by experienced gemologists. Its service scope encompasses colored gemstone identification, origin analysis and research, pearl testing and grading, diamond testing and grading, as well as precious metal type and purity verification. The laboratory currently operates facilities in Guangzhou and Shenzhen, China, as well as Beruwala, Sri Lanka, with a representative office located in Pforzheim, Germany. Since its establishment, the CGRL team has consistently focused on the research and development of testing technologies for colored gemstones and pearls, along with origin analysis and standardization promotion. We have successfully established color grading systems and origin tracing research for rubies, sapphires, emeralds, and other gemstones, and have introduced systematic identification and grading standards for both saltwater and freshwater pearls. Upholding the core values of "Professionalism" and "Rigor," we remain committed to providing the jewelry industry with professional and reliable gemstone testing services based on our extensive expertise.

Company Background: Hong Kong Pearl Association was founded on 16 November 2001. It is a dedicated trade association in Hong Kong to promote pearl industry. Most of our members are pearl traders engaging in all kinds of business related to Chinese freshwater pearls or other pearl categories, namely cultivating, processing, exporting, importing, wholesaling, retailing, etc. Many of them make strong investments in Mainland China, which are in large-scale and internationalized. The founding of this HKPA is based on the priority of protecting members interests. Despite its commercial nature, we also commit to the cause of social responsibility. Therefore we wish to make the following objectives known to our members: 1. Serve Hong Kong pearl industry. 2. Safeguard the lawful rights and interests of pearl traders. 3. Stabilize the production order of the pearl industry. 4. Further mutual understanding, fraternal cooperation and experience sharing among companies coming from pearl industry and other related industries. 5. Improve technology and scientific management of the pearl industry. 6. Strengthen the competitive power of Chinese freshwater pearl in the international market. 7. To promote the local pearl industry as well as contribute to the economics in a constructive and positive way.

Company Background: AIGS Lab founded by Henry Ho in 1978, is Asia's first professional lab, located in Bangkok's Jewelry Trade Center. It offers expert analysis of colored gemstones, especially rubies, sapphires, emeralds, jade, spinel and rare stones. The Lab specializes in identifying natural vs treated gemstones, detecting treatments (e.g. heat, diffusion, oiling), and recognizing synthetic gems, including CVD and HPHT diamonds. Using advanced tools like DFI, FTIR, UV-Vis-NIR, EDXRF, LIBS and high-resolution microscopes, AIGS also studies gem origins and treatments through inclusion patterns and chemical analysis. Reports include clear identification, treatment detection, origin opinions when applicable. AIGS maintains a large reference database and collaborates globally to stay current. Beyond lab services, AIGS also runs a leading gemological school, offering programs such as the Accredited Gemologist (A.G.) Diploma. Website: www.aigsthailand.com
